market_view: Risk-off tape: oil down 7.5% on Iran diplomacy, a China lithography report sank semis (Nasdaq 100 in correction), VIX 18.7, Fed meeting today. 10y yield 4.64% and a firm dollar keep gold weak.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI -7.5% on Iran diplomacy is a driver move already in the price; reversal either way is a guess. Only analyst notes and CVX earnings preview on July 31; no XOM-specific catalyst.

gold_miners.reasoning: Only analyst notes on NEM (Barclays target trim to $124, a bullish blog). No guidance change. Gold flat in 20 days, yields high, dollar firm.

chips.reasoning: Nvidia investing in SSI is a minor demand-side item; the sector selloff on China lithography news is a driver move with no reason to expect a reversal. Rout is not a catalyst for a long.

pharma.catalyst: Continuing the LLY long opened 2026-07-23 on the retatrutide phase 3 wins ahead of an FDA filing (previous handoff); no adverse LLY news in today's headlines.
pharma.reasoning: Hold to the 10-day horizon (about day 3 now). The filing path is still ahead and not fully priced. LLY was flat on the day while the sector was strong. Thesis intact, so no reason to exit early.

copper_uranium.reasoning: SCCO Q2 beat (Yahoo, July 27) and analyst target raises are peer read-through and already priced; FCX is up 6.7% in 5 days. No FCX-specific catalyst.

would_change_my_mind: An LLY safety, FDA or China-probe negative would exit LLY; a real Iran supply disruption, an NVDA-specific shock or a guidance raise by NEM or FCX would open a long.

handoff.what_changed: WTI fell 7.5% on Iran diplomacy headlines; a China lithography report hit semis and the Nasdaq 100 entered a correction. JNJ announced a $5.5B talc settlement; SCCO beat Q2 estimates. LLY has no new news; the long continues.

oil_gas.why: Oil drop on diplomacy is a priced driver move; no XOM-specific catalyst.

gold_miners.why: Only analyst notes on NEM; gold and miners stay weak against high yields.

chips.why: Sector rout on China lithography news is not a catalyst for a long; NVDA's SSI investment is minor.

pharma.why: Retatrutide phase 3 wins ahead of an FDA filing; thesis intact, no adverse news.

copper_uranium.why: SCCO beat is a priced peer read-through; no FCX-specific catalyst.
